prior_receipts: Preserved unchanged as historical records. Recovery metadata and original manifests remain authoritative and unchanged.
scope: Only immutable archive payloads and archive metadata read; decoded payloads inspected in memory, one file at a time; immediate durable per-file results written via small official apply_patch calls.
rules: Full decoded UTF-8 text scanned for private-key blocks, provider-secret tokens, literal bearer credentials, JWTs, credentials in URLs, literal sensitive assignments, marked reasoning blocks/transcript channels.
JSON traversed for sensitive credential and private-reasoning fields. Obvious test/dummy/reference placeholders excluded from credential-value findings.
Structured image data and opaque base64 values were counted, not decoded or interpreted. No candidate values printed or included in metadata.
limitations: This is bounded automated inspection, not a universal secrecy guarantee or human semantic review.
Opaque/encoded/encrypted secrets, unmarked private prose, and unsupported credential formats may evade these rules.
Public clearance means inspected without a detected finding under these rules, not a new product approval.
integrity: All 328 compressed and decompressed hashes/sizes match exact existing records. All pre-existing archive files rehashed unchanged.
operations: No source/current UI/parent-check access; no product tests/build/probes; no Git/index/staging/commit/network; no new helper source or further raw deletion.
